theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_tg_cg_borel_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P Q : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (D : Set (Eucl n)) (γ : Eucl n → Eucl Q), MeasurableSet D → ContinuousOn Φ D → InjOn Φ D → Measurable γ → ∃ g : Eucl P → Eucl Q, Measurable g ∧ (∀ w ∈ D, g (Φ w) = γ w) ∧ ∀ y, y ∉ Φ '' D → g y = 0
